5198041379.news_topic: Generative AI Drives Major Productivity Gains Across Businesses
5198041379.current_draft:
Everyone's talking about AI like it's the answer to everything.

It's not.

We've been tracking the data across dozens of professional service businesses. The pattern is clear.

AI works when you already know what works. When your sales process is documented. When you understand which touchpoints actually convert clients.

Most businesses don't have that clarity yet.

They're adding AI to broken systems and wondering why nothing changes. You can't automate what you haven't defined.

The companies seeing real productivity gains aren't the ones with the most AI tools. They're the ones who mapped their client journey first. Who tested their conversion points. Who knew their baseline numbers.

AI is an accelerator, not a foundation.

If you don't have a repeatable process for turning leads into clients, start there. Document what's working. Kill what isn't. Build something systematic.

Then add AI to scale it.

The productivity gains are real. But only if you've done the foundational work first.
